\begin{example} \end{example}1. Example 2.5\group ch02-maximum-principles Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0030

For $\Omega =(0,\pi )^2$, the nonzero function $u(x,y)=\sin x\sin y$ satisfies \[ \Delta u+2u=0\quad \text{in }\Omega , \qquad u=0\quad \text{on }\partial \Omega . \] \end{example}
